title: penstemon campanulatus
intro: Penstemon campanulatus, commonly known as the Bellflower Penstemon, is a species of flowering plant in the family Plantaginaceae. This plant is known for its bell-shaped flowers and has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Penstemon campanulatus include its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which may help to ease congestion and promote coughing up of mucus. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
